mapper.select: SELECT id,name,description,created_at,updated_at FROM project ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id,p.name,p.description,p.created_at,p.updated_at,m.role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id=p.id) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.project_id=p.id) AS task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.project_id=p.id AND t.status='DONE') AS done_count FROM project p JOIN project_member m ON m.project_id=p.id AND m.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM project WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
